source_code_authority.native_flux_sign: bottom flux is negative conductivity times the hydraulic gradient; free drainage explicitly sets qbot=-kmean(numnod+1)

mismatch.p5b_estimator: Internal pressure-head slope among retained bottom cells, q=-K*(1-dh/dd).
mismatch.actual_operator: Boundary-interface pressure-head difference between the bottom state and prescribed hbot over the bottom center-to-face distance.
mismatch.consequence: P5B's very large sign mismatch counts and flux errors cannot adjudicate whether storage split or hydraulic-shape information is useful for the actual prescribed-head boundary response.

disposition.next_phase: P5C prospectively tests equal-budget boundary-interface state estimators against the exact SWBOTB=5 operator.
